english.note: This is the all-purpose everyday noun for a bodily injury or wound.
Use this for physical injury, such as a wound or bodily hurt; use 損害 for damage to possessions.

examples.english: I still have some injury in my leg, so walking hurts.
examples.traditional: 我隻腳仲有啲傷，行路會痛。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 zek3 goek3 zung6 jau5 di1 soeng1 haang4 lou6 wui5 tung3

examples.english: The wound on my leg is still causing me harm.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 zek3 goek3 ge3 soeng1 zung6 tung3 gan2
